analogy.rationale: Caspases are apoptosis executioners whose inhibition alone produces little transcriptional change in these proliferating cell lines, since the 978 landmark genes are not strongly apoptosis-focused and caspase inhibition does not create a distinct shared downstream program. The closest listed classes are other apoptosis-pathway modulators, but even these share only weak transcriptional similarity.
